subsystem.name: GUI Desktop Viewport & 2.5D Tactical Presentation
axioms: Presentation follows simulation: GUI never mutates state directly
Double-buffered offscreen rendering eliminates tearing artifacts
Non-overlapping panel and widget geometry strictly audited via AABB checks
Asset abstraction guarantees seamless transition from procedural to artist sprites
Headless fallback cleanly downgrades to CLI in DISPLAY absence
